title: Crossvariant Regression Logbook — Mar 2026
content:
Purpose:

This logbook records a cross-variant onboarding comparison run of three candidate model versions (candidate-A, candidate-B, candidate-C) against the current production pinned variant (prod-v1.4). The focus is regression detection on critical prompt cohorts, a compact leaderboard oriented around utility (task success), safety regressions, and latency cost tradeoffs. This is intended to be a single-source decision artifact for a canary rollout recommendation.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Candidate-B shows the best overall task-success uplift (+3.5% relative) but has a reproducible regression in the "financial-numeric-extraction" cohort (precision drop ~9 pts).
- Candidate-A is conservative (small gains, no safety regressions) and has slightly higher median latency (+12ms) at the standard 512-token workload.
- Candidate-C has mixed quality with higher hallucination rate on long-form instruction prompts and an unexplained degradation on a small subset of multi-turn dialog prompts.
- Recommendation: Proceed with a staged canary for candidate-B restricted to non-financial cohorts and with additional monitoring hooks for numeric-extraction checks; hold candidate-C for further root cause; consider candidate-A for low-risk customers if latency impact is acceptable.

Methodology summary:
- Prompt cohorts: we ran 18 cohorts derived from PROD telemetry and synthetic cover sets: conversational-multi-turn, short-instruction, coding-snippet-completion, financial-numeric-extraction, safety-sensitive, normalization/formatting, long-form-summarization, edgecase-entity-ambiguity, and 10 smaller micro-cohorts derived from high-failure prompts.
- Evaluation harness: deterministic eval harness (seeded sampling where applicable), 3-shot protocol for short instruction cohort, single-shot for others. We capture task-success (binary pass/fail against oracle or heuristic), exact-match when relevant, BLEU/ROUGE as auxiliary signals for long-form, and hallucination flags from the QA-sanity suite.
- Data split: 80/20 timed-run vs holdout for regression confirmation. The timed-run is what produced the leaderboard below; the holdout was used to validate top signals.
- Hardware: 2x A10G per candidate in the sandbox routing pool; perf numbers are median across 1,000 representative requests at 512 context tokens.

Compact leaderboard (timed-run aggregated metrics):

Rank | Variant       | TaskSuccessDelta | HallucRateDelta | MedianLat_ms | Notes
-----|---------------|------------------|-----------------|--------------|------
1    | candidate-B   | +3.5%            | +0.4%           | 88ms         | Best utility, finance regression flagged
2    | candidate-A   | +1.1%            | -0.1%           | 100ms        | Conservative, safe, slightly slower
3    | prod-v1.4     | baseline (0.0)   | 0.0%            | 87ms         | current baseline
4    | candidate-C   | -0.8%            | +1.9%           | 95ms         | Hallucination increase on long-form

Win/Loss snapshot (pairwise against prod-v1.4, aggregated across cohorts):
- candidate-B: wins 42%, ties 34%, losses 24% (net +18 pts)
- candidate-A: wins 23%, ties 51%, losses 26% (net -3 pts)
- candidate-C: wins 18%, ties 37%, losses 45% (net -27 pts)

Cohort-level notable regressions (high-confidence, validated on holdout):
1) financial-numeric-extraction (N=420 prompts):
   - candidate-B precision: 74% (prod: 83%) -> absolute drop 9 pts. Recall roughly stable. Failures are primarily around negative-value and parentheses-handling cases (examples included below).
   - Candidate-A and prod-v1.4: no significant change. Candidate-C: inconclusive (low sample performance variability).
   - Severity: HIGH for customers using structured extraction (banking, fintech).

2) long-form summarization (N=260):
   - candidate-C shows a +12% hallucination increase vs prod, with hallucinated entity insertions in the tail. Candidate-B and candidate-A are neutral. Severity: MEDIUM.

3) multi-turn instruction followups (edge dialog cohort, N=190):
   - candidate-C failed 3 reproducible prompts where pronoun resolution dropped; candidate-B shows minor improvements. Severity: LOW-MEDIUM.

Latency/cost notes:
- Candidate-A median latency higher by ~12ms vs prod; P95 differences are small (<5ms) — likely due to different attention kernel path introduced in compilation.
- Candidate-B matched prod median latency but shows slightly increased memory working set (estimated +8%), plan to verify on larger sequences.

Root-cause hypotheses and quick probes performed:
- Candidate-B finance regression: suspected tokenizer change + recent numeric-postprocessing tweak. Quick probe: forced prod tokenizer on candidate-B (sandbox build) recovered precision by ~6 pts (partial fix). Further investigation required in numeric-normalization pipeline.
- Candidate-C hallucination spike: correlated with new decoder temperature scheduling change during training; running ablation with steady temperature reduced hallucination by ~7%.

Representative failing prompts (sanitized) for the finance cohort that reproduce candidate-B regression:
- "Extract values and currencies from: (Invoice 443) - Amount: -$1,234.56; tax included?" -> candidate-B omitted parentheses-sign handling; prod-v1.4 handles OK.
- "List negative balances and attach sign: Account A: (123.45)" -> candidate-B returned values without negative marker.

Safety regressions:
- No new safety policy violations found in standard safety-sensitive cohort (N=530) for candidate-B or candidate-A beyond statistical noise. Candidate-C had 2 examples flagged by heuristic filters (both low confidence and require manual review).

Canary rollout recommendation matrix:
- Candidate-B: Canary-OK with constraints. Routes: non-financial cohorts only (tag-based routing), canary size 5% of traffic for 48h, auto-rollback if precision on numeric-extraction drops >5 pts on live telemetry or if user-facing error-rate rises >0.5%. Add a synthetic numeric-extraction probe every 5 minutes.
- Candidate-A: Recommend as a "safe secondary" for low-risk customers or internal beta only; not broad canary due to latency uplift.
- Candidate-C: Do not promote. Requires a focused RCA on temperature scheduling and decoder training config.

Decision log (deciders + signoffs):
- Draft recommendation authored by: Asha Patel (eng-applied-ml)
- Reviewed by: Miguel Ramos (applied-ml), Ellen Cho (platform), Samir Kapadia (SRE)
- Pending final: Product lead (CC: Priya Nair) and Security review for canary monitoring signals.

Next steps and action items (owner tags):
- Asha: Open follow-up investigation ticket for tokenization/numeric-normalization (ENG-1292). Include unit tests that contain parenthesis/negative-value cases. (ETA 2026-03-22)
- Miguel: Run a larger sequence memory regression test on candidate-B (2k token sequences) and report memory delta. (ETA 2026-03-19)
- Ellen: Prepare canary route config (tag-based exclusion for finance cohorts) and synthetic probe pipeline. (ETA 2026-03-20)
- Samir: Add additional alerting rule for numeric-extraction degradation and validate SLAs on the canary cluster. (ETA 2026-03-20)

Appendix: lightweight metric definitions used in this doc:
- TaskSuccess: Binary pass/fail against golden extraction pattern or human-labeled pass.
- HallucRate: fraction of responses with hallucinated entities detected by QA-sanity heuristics and human adjudication sample.
- MedianLat_ms: median server-side processing time measured from HTTP receive to final chunk sent (excludes network egress).

Appendix B: short timeline of runs performed:
- 2026-03-10: Preliminary timed-run across 18 cohorts (1k samples/variant) -> produced candidate-B uplift signal
- 2026-03-11: Focused finance-cohort rerun (N=420) -> reproduced candidate-B precision drop
- 2026-03-12: Holdout validation (sanity) -> confirmed regression on holdout set
- 2026-03-13: Tokenizer-forcing probe -> partial recovery observed
- 2026-03-15: Larger long-form ablation on candidate-C -> hallucination reduction with temp ablation

If you want, I can extract a short 1-slide summary for the product/pm exec audience and a CSV-ready table of per-prompt deltas for ingestion into the regression monitoring dashboard.
